posts.hook: OpenAI now faces a legal front run by state attorneys, not just families
posts.caption: eight states sue openai over chatgpt and child safety, anthropic says revenue rose 45% while growth slows, a hack hit the fridge controllers of about 700 french supermarkets. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT put profit over child safety
slides.desc: Consumer-protection law opens a second front beyond the family suits.

slides.title: Anthropic told IPO investors that ==growth is slowing== and distillation is 5% to 7% of revenue
slides.desc: Strong revenue, but the valuation story has a ceiling.

terms.gloss: copying a top model's outputs to train a rival

slides.title: A fridge hack hit an estimated ==700 French supermarkets==
slides.desc: The controllers allowed remote admin login and one brand used a date-derived password.

slides.title: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno to strengthen its Workers platform
slides.desc: Workers gets a first-party runtime team.

terms.gloss: a javascript runtime for running server code
cloudflare's platform for running code at the edge

slides.title: Microsoft and Japan took down a phishing marketplace behind 1B+ messages
slides.desc: Selling the kits was the business, so the marketplace was the target.

posts.hook: Your next ad could be the attack, and nobody has to click
posts.caption: citizen lab says an israeli ad firm helped spyware makers infect devices through ads alone, the ftc subpoenaed openai and anthropic over safety incidents, nvidia's arm-based rtx spark laptops ship friday. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Researchers say an Israeli ad firm delivered ==zero-click spyware== through ordinary ads
slides.desc: First technical evidence of this attack via targeted advertising, per Citizen Lab.

terms.gloss: an attack that needs no tap or open from the victim
a university research group that tracks government spyware

slides.title: The FTC subpoenaed OpenAI and Anthropic in a safety incidents probe
slides.desc: A federal investigation joins the morning's state lawsuits.

terms.gloss: the US agency that polices unfair business practices

slides.title: OpenAI warned staff about honey pots and insider threats before the arrest
slides.desc: Execs told staff to adopt operational security measures, per the WSJ.

slides.title: Nvidia's Arm laptops ship Friday, promising existing Windows apps still run
slides.desc: The 2012 Surface on an Nvidia Arm chip could not run them and flopped.

terms.gloss: a chip design used in phones, now moving into Windows laptops

slides.title: Modal raised at a ==$16B valuation== on $1B in annual revenue
slides.desc: Its sandboxes for running agent-written code are a $300M product alone.

terms.gloss: isolated mini-computers where untrusted code runs safely

slides.title: Nvidia and Apple gave $25M each to Trump's White House ballroom
slides.desc: Microsoft and Palantir gave $10M each, Meta and Amazon $5M.
